title: Evening AM L experiment scratchpad - Nora
content:
Context:
- Late-night scratchpad for quick experiment notes and next-step TODOs. Meant to be ephemeral.
- Goal: try low-precision quant strategies + small-runtime changes to reduce host memory and per-token latency for long-chat workloads (8k+ context).

Quick summary:
- Tried: 4bit asymmetric (GPTQ-like) + dynamic KV truncation heuristics.
- Observed: ~12% median latency reduction on batch=1 sampling with 8k context, but increased p95 tail when a long prefix causes cache trimming.
- Perf tradeoff: quality drop measured by small eval set (dialog_recall_small) moderate: ROUGE-L -0.9, assistant reply coherence issues in ~3/60 prompts.

Runs (notes):
- run_2026-03-28_nq1: model: redwood-mono-7B-epoch32-quant4a, config: chunked-attn disabled, batching=1, kv-truncation: 'half-every-2048'.
  - metrics: latency_med=72ms/token, latency_p95=180ms/token, tok/sec=13, peak_gpu_mem=7.1GB, host_ram=9.2GB.
  - eval (dialog_recall_small, 60 examples): rougeL=0.71 -> baseline fp16 0.719; coherence flagged by human spot-check 3/60.
  - notes: when prefix length hopped over 4096, p95 spiked to 240ms/token.

- run_2026-03-28_nq2: model: same quant but kv-truncation='adaptive:score-threshold-0.002'.
  - metrics: latency_med=70ms/token, latency_p95=150ms/token, tok/sec=14, peak_gpu_mem=7.0GB, host_ram=9.0GB.
  - eval: rougeL=0.708; coherence issues 2/60.
  - notes: adaptive heuristic smoother, but some hallucination cases where old context with high importance was truncated incorrectly. Need a fast importance estimator.

- run_2026-03-28_nq3: model: redwood-mono-7B-epoch32-quant4a + kv-cache-priority by recency-only (truncate oldest tokens).
  - metrics: latency_med=68ms/token, latency_p95=200ms/token (bad tail), tok/sec=14.5, peak_gpu_mem=6.9GB.
  - notes: simple recency truncation helps median but tail suffers when a sudden long response added; queueing interaction with batch formation causes head-of-line delay.

Prompt sets used (kept short for fast eval):
- few_shot_summary_v1: 3 examples, style='concise-extract', instructions emphasis on 'preserve entity links' (used for rougeL compute).
- long_context_recall: 10 simulated turns with info scattered across earlier turns (used to test retrieval from KV cache under truncation).
- safety-smoke: 20 short adversarial prompts to check misbehavior after quantization.

Qualitative notes:
- 4-bit asymmetric quant appears stable for most dialog tokens but struggles on mathematical expression preservation (lossy tokens in code/math).
- Observed occasional token selection jitter on aleatory tails—candidate beam-scores noisier.
- Human spot-check: truncation errors cause missing reference lines in persona tasks -> user-visible regression.

Ideas to try next (short-term):
- Implement a micro-importance estimator: cheap heuristic using attention-sum proxy computed from last n layers (n=2) to rank KV entries. Aim for <=3ms overhead.
- Try mixed qconfig: first 2 layers fp16 / rest 4-bit to test sensitivity to head-layer precision.
- Test 'soft-truncate' where truncated KV entries pushed to host memory (compressed) and rehydrated on demand. Measure host I/O penalty.
- Run a cheap A/B with fp16 baseline on 200 examples to get better stat power for rouge/bleu drop.

Microbench snippets / commands (for my memory):
- start script: ./runtime/bin/fast_infer --model ./artifacts/redwood-mono-7B-epoch32-quant4a --quant-config quant4a.json --kv-policy adaptive:0.002 --batch 1 --stream false 
- profile: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 ./runtime/bin/microbench --profile tokens --seq 8192 --warm 5 --iters 100 

Quick TODO (priority ordered):
- [ ] Implement cheap attention-sum importance estimator prototype (owner: me) — target: prototype by 2026-04-01.
- [ ] Add small regression CI: 500-example dialog_recall set; auto-check rougeL and p95 latency (owner: Liam).
- [ ] Post notes and ask SRE about host-swapping feasibility for 'soft-truncate' (owner: Diego).
- [ ] Run mixed-precision layer-ablation (layers 0..1 fp16) across 100 eval prompts (owner: me).

Open questions / unknowns:
- How deterministic is the quant4a mapping across different GPUs? Need to verify binary equivalence across Ampere vs Blackwell test nodes.
- Host-swapping compressed KV: what compressor gives best time/space trade for typical token embeddings? zstd-3? lz4? Need a microbench.
- Is p95 dominated by model compute or by our batch formation codepath? Need flame graphs on tail runs.

Misc scratch reminders:
- Save run logs under artifacts/quant/2026-03-28/ (done).
- Mention this experiment in standup tomorrow if we decide adaptive heuristic is promising.
- If human spot-check shows >5% failure on persona tasks, we should rollback quant profile for dedicated customers.

One-line end note to self:
- Adaptive KV + tiny layer-fp16 looks promising — avoid rolling into Dedicated until we have regression CI

End of scratchpad (ephemeral).
